messages.author: 6445c6a7b4eb1c70
messages.subject: Setting up multilevel SEM
parts:
I have multilevel data on disease infections in people, who are clustered inside households. 

There is one main response variable, Z, that is measured at the person-level - essentially, were they infected? I then also have several individual-level risk factors, X1, X2, X3, etc. (that differ between people, like where they work), as well as several household-level risk factors Y1, Y2, Y3, etc. (that differ between houses but are the same for every person inside that house, like if the household cooks their meat before consumption).

Can I set up a 2-level SEM with Z as the only response variable? Most examples I've seen include separate responses at the first and second level, but I may just be reading it wrong :)

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Setting up multilevel SEM
parts: Can I set up a 2-level SEM with Z as the only response variable?

Yes, a Level-1 outcome variable will have a Level-1 component that can be explained by Level-1 predictors, and a Level-2 component that can be explained by Level-2 predictors.  But lavaan does not (yet, or for the foreseeable future) implement MLSEMs with categorical endogenous variables.

https://lavaan.ugent.be/development.html

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Setting up multilevel SEM
parts: do I need a separate response at the household level or can I still use household-level variables to predict the individual-level response Z?

Level-1 and -2 components of observed variables will have the same name at both levels.  Exogenous Level-1 variables are not required (programmatically) to be partitioned into Level-1 and -2 components (see the ?Demo.twolevel help-page example), but they probably should be:

https://doi.org/10.1111/bmsp.12194

Basically, will this work:

level: 1 
Z ~ X1 + X2 + X3

level: 2 
Z ~ Y1 + Y2 + Y3
